review_mode: Independent agent reading of all four exercise pages, exact arithmetic, joint-kernel consistency and primary-source comparison
result: Scientific assumptions, KRR arithmetic, separate PSD counterexample, measurement counts and time thresholds pass

calculation.execution_level: Classical rational arithmetic and numerical pure-state existence witness; no scikit-learn execution, eight-qubit circuit, QPU or DFT run
checks: The fixed training-label mean is 0.20 eV; centering labels rather than changing the kernel gives alpha=(-0.10,0.10) eV.
Predictions are 0.14 and 0.18 eV, with single-point absolute errors 0.030 and 0.010 eV. One error is not an independent-test population MAE.
Appending the test point with self-kernel one gives joint quantum and classical Gram determinants 0.23 and 0.47, respectively. All principal minors are positive.

Quantum fidelity realizability is established separately by explicit pure states |0>, |+> and sqrt(4/5)|0>+sqrt(1/5)exp(i theta)|1>, with cos(theta)=-3/4. This proves consistency of the exercise fixture, not efficiency or implementation of its unspecified feature circuit.

The unrelated B matrix has determinant -0.28 and eigenvalues 1, 1 plus/minus sqrt(1.28). Adding 0.5I makes this shifted regression matrix positive definite but does not establish that the original measurements formed a consistent kernel.

19900 training and 4000 prediction pairs require 23900000 shots at 1000 shots per pair. Measurement takes 4780 seconds and the full quantum path 5680 seconds; the hypothetical classical path is 360 seconds.

With 900 seconds left for measurement, the exact rate threshold is 239000/9 shots per second, or 26556 if rounded up to an integer. At the current rate, 188 shots per pair fits while 189 exceeds thirty minutes.
The maximum elementwise binomial standard error is about 0.0158 and is dimensionless, not an eV prediction error.
Eighty CPU-hours is a gross replacement upper bound. Running twenty new DFT validation jobs still incurs those eighty CPU-hours and does not demonstrate a saving in that batch.

joint_kernel_critique.training_and_test_values: The K off-diagonal 0.5 and quantum test vector (0.8,0.2) are mutually consistent. B is expressly a separate measurement batch.
joint_kernel_critique.necessary_vs_sufficient: PSD of a nonnegative unit-diagonal matrix is a necessary test for a pure-state fidelity Gram matrix; it is not used here as a universal sufficient realizability criterion. The explicit state construction provides the additional witness for this particular fixture.
joint_kernel_critique.scope: The witness is a classical mathematical calculation. It neither specifies the exercise's U(x) nor runs a quantum circuit. The one-qubit states can be embedded in an eight-qubit Hilbert space by adjoining unused |0> qubits.
joint_kernel_critique.regularization_vs_repair: Ridge shifts the system used for regression. PSD projection changes an estimated kernel and can change its diagonal; an out-of-sample extension and evaluation procedure must remain consistent. Hidden test labels must not select the correction or hyperparameters.
joint_kernel_critique.causality: A negative determinant identifies an inconsistency, not which of sampling, calibration drift or correction procedures caused it.

en.title: Accuracy and kernel measurement cost in molecular prediction
en.summary: Changing molecular similarities changes a DFT surrogate’s predictions. An educational OLED regression case links kernel consistency, held-out error and measurement load, then asks which DFT calculations are truly avoided after validation costs.

listing.review: Titles and separate listing summaries match the exercise, identify the educational application and contain no numerical answers or deployment verdicts.

checks: Both languages preserve the arithmetic, units, label centering, independent-test scope and initially closed answer structure.
The introduction describes the energetic cost of molecular structural reorganization upon charge-state change while keeping the DFT target separate from device lifetime or mobility.
The unrelated B audit is not used to invalidate the consistent K/kQ training-test fixture.
Ridge regularization, kernel correction and empirical physical consistency remain distinct.
Shot noise is dimensionless kernel error rather than an eV prediction error; throughput and reduced-shot thresholds are hypothetical arithmetic conditions.
DFT replacement upper bounds, validation costs, CPU-hours and elapsed time remain distinct.
Reference first-use order is 1, 2, 3; all original title words, verified author credits, bibliography and links match between languages and the final PDF.
The full-paper/experiment access limitations and actual selected readings are disclosed without claiming a full reproduction.

PDF_reference_check.scope: Final page four bibliography directly extracted/read; author credits, original title words, publication details and documentation version match both web editions. PDF uses ASCII hyphens for page ranges; web typography uses en dashes.
